notes.title: Release Date
notes.content: Our new game counts with a lot of much more new content for you to enjoy. In order to set everything perfect we've put all our care and attention for this to be a full suspense and horror experience. Therefore the release date for Damned Hours has been posponed up to October the 2nd in order to have the new maps, missions and game sets ready for you to have the best game experience. In Delusion Arts we can't afford but that, the best experience in all of our games. So beware! And wait for there is so little time now for you to play the legend.
